profile.name: TTI PL330P直流电源
profile.description: TTI PL330P 是一款可编程台式直流电源，输出范围为 0–32 V、0–3 A。它用于为实验电路、模块或原型提供可调直流电压与电流，并可远程控制输出开关。
profile.description_en: The TTI PL330P is a programmable bench DC power supply with a 0–32 V, 0–3 A output range. It is used to provide adjustable DC voltage and current to laboratory circuits, modules, or prototypes, with remote control of the output state.
